name: Maineiax Lacrosse Boys & Girls Summer Camps
description_short: Half-day, 4-day lacrosse camps for boys and girls in grades 2–8, held outdoors on town fields in several Maine towns. Players are grouped by age and skill level, and you register through each town's Parks & Recreation department.
refund_policy_summary: Sessions canceled because of bad weather are not rescheduled or refunded. The site also links to a separate Business & Refund Policy that was not included in this source.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season, which is over (today is 2026-10-13). The 2027 dates, towns and grades may be different.
Registration and payment go through each town's Parks & Recreation department, not Maineiax. The town links were not included in this source, so there is no registration URL.
The grade range is listed as 'Grades 2nd – 8th (fall 2026)', meaning the grade the child enters in fall 2026.
